status: Proposed after the exploratory survey; no archaeological fitting or hypothesis test performed
shared_requirements: Specify outcome, boundary, horizon, tolerated interruption and resident access.
Keep observations, authors' explanations and proposed mechanisms separate.
Use independent demand and supply bounds; unknown ceilings cannot justify a positive minimum-renewal result.
Freeze coding and competing models before comparing later outcomes; retain failed, censored and unresolved cases.

comparisons.title: Service and its next renewal
comparisons.hypothesis: Loss of a required replacement route can precede loss of service by the remaining working life of existing assets.
measures: Access to replacement materials, expertise and work
comparisons.rejects_this_account: Service persists beyond every admissible output limit after all proposed replacement/acquisition alternatives are independently excluded.
comparisons.unresolved_when: Asset output, demand or outside supply lacks a defensible bound.
comparisons.prior_relation: Viability and economic reproduction already express the mechanism; the proposed extension specifies archaeological joins.

comparisons.title: Shared renewal dates and work windows
comparisons.hypothesis: Co-acquired assets can place replacement obligations in the same limited window even where average annual inputs are sufficient.
measures: Crew, transport, material and skill overlap
comparisons.rejects_this_account: The reconstructed tasks admit schedules under every supported shared-resource realization, or the supposed common deadlines disappear under better dating.
comparisons.unresolved_when: Chronological uncertainty is wider than the proposed overlap or work window.
comparisons.prior_relation: Integrated restoration scheduling and coupled institutional pathways are direct predecessors; no new scheduling theorem is claimed.

comparisons.title: Provider numbers and upstream independence
comparisons.hypothesis: Several visible providers can retain one vulnerable prerequisite, while materially different providers can offer functional substitutes.
measures: Options after a declared prerequisite loss
comparisons.rejects_this_account: The allegedly shared prerequisite has independently supported substitutes that preserve the specified operations after its removal.
comparisons.unresolved_when: Routes or product resemblance are the only evidence of dependence.
comparisons.prior_relation: Networks, interdependent infrastructure and Jervis's material/network integration precede the proposed sourcing comparison.

comparisons.title: Local outcomes and external support
comparisons.hypothesis: Urban contraction can coincide with continued resident provisioning or expertise through movement, changed demand and outside supply.
measures: Production capabilities within regional and local boundaries
rivals: Imported finished products without local expertise
comparisons.rejects_this_account: The specified service or capability ends across the complete supported receiving network, rather than continuing under a changed local outcome.
comparisons.unresolved_when: Resident access, origins or receiving settlements are unobserved.
comparisons.prior_relation: Outcome separation, multiscale transformation and imported provisioning are explicit prior mechanisms.

comparisons.title: Expertise and access to successors
comparisons.hypothesis: The cadence of required operations and access to teachers or recruits can constrain skill renewal even when experienced practitioners remain available now.
comparisons.rejects_this_account: The defined capability continues across independently supported cohort turnover despite the proposed complete loss of teacher/recruitment routes.
comparisons.unresolved_when: Only a change in finished-product frequency is observed.
comparisons.prior_relation: Effective learning networks, partial connectivity and inventive apprenticeship precede this conditional cadence comparison.

comparisons.title: Technical opportunity, participation and access
comparisons.hypothesis: Work can be technically feasible while contribution rules, information or unequal access prevent its enactment or limit whom it serves.
comparisons.rejects_this_account: The predicted participation barrier is absent in independently supported enactment and access evidence while the service still fails for another identified reason.
comparisons.unresolved_when: A completed facility is the only evidence for contributions, rules or beneficiaries.
comparisons.prior_relation: Institutional robustness, polycentricity and heterogeneous costs/benefits already provide the mechanism.

comparisons.title: Chronology and observation controls
comparisons.hypothesis: Coarse phases, site visibility and outcome selection can create apparent continuity or task overlap.
comparisons.rejects_this_account: The proposed artifact explanation disappears under independently improved chronology and equivalent observation coverage.
comparisons.unresolved_when: The comparison's proposed event scale is finer than its dating resolution.
comparisons.prior_relation: Duration definitions and temporal criticism already identify these limits; this is a common control for the six substantive comparisons.
